content: {"paper_id":"W3000116636","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"subspace-clustering","exact_quote":"The new model improves its physical interpretability by ensuring that the query sample should be approximated from homogeneous samples and irrelevant to heterogeneous ones.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"所提 LapNR 通过自表达使查询样本由同类样本近似、与异类样本无关，并用于聚类，符合以自表达关系分组的子空间聚类任务。"},{"keyword_id":"dimensionality-reduction","exact_quote":"Laplacian Regularized Nonnegative Representation for Clustering and Dimensionality Reduction","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题明确将 LapNR 用于降维，且摘要报告降维任务实验，属于显式降维研究。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","exact_quote":"it captures the geometric information of input data by imposing the graph Laplacian to the nonnegative representations","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"通过图拉普拉斯对非负表示施加几何一致性约束，捕获输入数据几何信息，符合图与流形正则化定义。"},{"keyword_id":"sparse-representation","exact_quote":"the representation matrix generated by our LapNR model becomes sparse and discriminative","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"LapNR 的表示矩阵变得稀疏，即样本由少量同类样本表示，符合稀疏表示机制。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
